identify: The photo model matched this to the rice stem borer.
Dead heart in the young plant and white ear head are signs of stem borer damage.
The yellow stem borer is a major rice pest in India.
damage: The larva bores into the stem.

thresholds.etl: Early to late tillering: 2 egg-mass/m2 or 10% dead heart or 1 moth/m2 or 25 moths/ trap/week.

cultural: Clip the tips of the seedlings before you transplant them.
Plough the field after harvest and flood it to kill the larvae in the stubble.
biological: Release Trichogramma japonicum at 1 lakh/ha when you see egg masses or moths.
Collect egg masses and keep them in a bamboo cage so that the egg parasites can escape.

stage_notes.seedling: In the nursery, act when you see 1 egg-mass/m2.
